description: This is a PHP class defining logic hooks for Opportunities module in SugarCRM, particularly related to geocoding info updates and handling related entity relationships.

classes.name: OpportunitiesJjwg_MapsLogicHook
classes.description: Defines logic hook methods for the Opportunities module, managing geocoding updates and relationship changes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class and loads module info for 'jjwg_Maps'.

methods.name: updateGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode information for the Opportunity bean before save if enabled.

methods.name: updateRelatedProjectGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Projects after Opportunity save.

methods.name: updateRelatedMeetingsGeocodeInfo
methods.description: Updates geocode info for related Meetings after Opportunity save.

methods.name: addRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocode updates when a new relationship is added.

methods.name: deleteRelationship
methods.description: Handles geocode updates when a relationship is deleted.
